info.name: Get the rendered SEO head for a URL

params.name: url
params.description: The URL whose SEO head should be rendered.

items.docs: Renders the Yoast SEO head for a bioaegistherapeutics.com URL, returning both the raw HTML (`html`) and a parsed object (`json`). The parsed object carries the canonical URL, robots directives, Open Graph and Twitter card metadata, and — under `json.schema['@graph']` — the site's schema.org JSON-LD graph (WebPage, BreadcrumbList, WebSite, Organization). This is the richest structured-data source on the surface and the only anonymously readable operation in the 53-route `yoast/v1` namespace.
